summary: Chat 6 deterministic integration planning is active. Current-main source/hash drift is non-relevant to worker physical authority, but direct Control Plane validation exposed interoperability blockers: Chat 3 candidate records are not schema-compatible with the current Control Plane envelope, Chats 1/2/4 have manifest-envelope mismatches, and the current reconciliation fingerprint cannot group different targets/surfaces because it includes surfaceKey and targetId.

blockers.detail: All 271 Mobile outcome rows fail current Control Plane candidate validation: top-level projection object is an unknown field; ndcRefs contains qualified 'ndc::SURF.mb.owner_home' instead of a raw NDC ID; evidenceRefs contain unqualified repo/path strings; Atlasfin adapter is stored as 'atlasfin::ADP.MB.TOUCH.V2' instead of the registry raw ID expected by Atlasfin normalization. This does not authorize silent rewriting.

Direct validate_shard semantics reject Chat 1 and Chat 4 because top-level inputCensusCount/inputTargetCount is absent; Chat 2 additionally uses schema prisma.visual-promotion.surface-candidate-manifest.v1 rather than prisma.visual-promotion.candidate-shard.v1. Row-level candidate content otherwise preserves zero-loss/unique target accounting.

Current candidate_fingerprint includes surfaceKey and targetId. Across 2,097 worker outcome rows it yields 2,097 singleton groups and therefore no cross-surface reconciliation group. Canonical promotion must not rely on this key for semantic coalescing without a separately authorized bounded correction/review key.

findings: Factory Ledger capability visual.generic_application_engine_v1 is DONE/SOURCE_READY with doNotRebuild=true; Chat 6 reused and advanced existing machinery rather than rebuilding it.
Current Visual Control census and Target Index are reusable physical truth. DISCOVERY_ONLY is not UNDISCOVERED and broad recensus is not a legal shortcut.
Atlasfin structured registries are the priority visual reference for this cohort. Materiality Catalog was never inspected or used as fallback and remains STANDBY_USER_INVOKED_ONLY.
PRISMA GVAE All-Surface Authority auto-materialized prisma-html/FILES_MANIFEST.json while PR #541 was open. Closing that PR stopped the lane-branch mutation loop.
Final work tree is byte-equivalent to the CI-validated code head cb21ca01ecf8ec755fe34820d3d5b34673f70581: compare cb21..7cc48f reports zero changed files.
Canonical continuation now provides explicit worker refs for Chats 1-5 and places Chat 6 in deterministic integration-planning mode.
All six current status mailboxes report READY_FOR_INTEGRATION. Several worker lanes retain truthful local/integration blockers, but none authorizes Chat 6 to resolve them by inference.

Exact base..current-main diff changes only coordination/governance files plus FILES_MANIFEST.json; no candidate canonicalSourcePath/generatedOutputPath or underlying product/RIFAT source path changed.

Source/hash revalidation by byte-equivalence passed for Tablet (40 unique recorded source/output paths), Mobile (14) and Shared UI (6); none intersects base..current-main changed paths. PC candidate rows do not carry per-row source/output hashes, so its manifest-level authority snapshots remain the relevant hash evidence.

Row-level structural/vocabulary validation passed 929/929 Tablet, 827/827 PC and 70/70 Shared UI before Atlasfin registry-existence checks. Mobile failed 271/271 for the schema/reference-envelope reasons recorded as a blocker.

Atlasfin current registries prove Tablet/PC recipe and adapter IDs. Mobile and Shared UI store qualified adapter strings in atlasfinAdapterId, which current Control Plane normalization expects as raw Atlasfin IDs.
Exact Control Plane collision logic found zero duplicate target IDs, zero bindingCandidateKey collisions and zero cross-surface fingerprint collisions across 2,097 outcome rows.
decisions: Preserve exactly GVAE_EXACT_APPLY, SURFACE_BATCH_PLAN, REGISTER_TARGET_FIRST and BLOCKED as Work Entry decisions.
Use REUSE_EXISTING_CENSUS_SEMANTIC_PROMOTION_REQUIRED and BROAD_REDISCOVERY_FORBIDDEN_CURRENT_CENSUS as machine-readable reasons, never as new decisions.
Canonical composer remains proposal-only: no canonical IDs assigned, no canonical registry mutation and no product/runtime mutation.
Candidate data remains candidate-only and authority-qualified; candidate is not authority and resolved binding is not mutation authorization.
Close PR #541 rather than keep allowing PR automation to write a forbidden global integration output onto the lane branch.
Leave FILES_MANIFEST.json unchanged from base on the Chat 6 lane. The interoperability contract assigns its one-time refresh to the later integration stage.
Treat current main movement as evidence to classify, not automatic semantic drift. Revalidate only recorded/relevant source and authority inputs.
Consume the exact worker heads named by the canonical continuation prompt; do not silently substitute newer lane commits.
Do not normalize Chat 3 or manifest envelopes in-place during planning. Preserve worker commits and represent required bounded corrections explicitly in the integration plan.
Treat zero current fingerprint collisions as an implementation property, not proof that no semantic cross-surface reconciliation exists.
